title: MemSnap μCheckpoints: A Data Single Level Store for Fearless Persistence
problem: Existing single level stores (EROS, Aurora, TreeSLS) checkpoint at coarse granularity and must combine with write-ahead logs and supplementary file persistence mechanisms, which undermines the unified benefits of the SLS design.
motivation: Single level stores promise to simplify data persistence by replacing file-based APIs with application checkpointing, offering a more integrated and efficient storage model.
method: MemSnap introduces μ(micro)-checkpoints that enable fine-grained, efficient checkpointing within single level stores without requiring supplementary write-ahead logs or external file persistence mechanisms. The approach integrates checkpoint management directly into memory and persistence layers.
key_novelty: Fine-grained micro-checkpointing mechanism that eliminates write-ahead log dependency in single level stores while maintaining data consistency.
contributions: Fine-grained μ-checkpointing mechanism for single level stores
Elimination of write-ahead log dependency in data persistence
Unified single level store design without supplementary file mechanisms
Fearless persistence model enabling simplified application checkpointing
primary_theme: fine-grained checkpointing for unified persistent storage
